A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BISR/BandInvMF research. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable matching despite substantial reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original factorization-error experiments, optimization-convergence results, and CIFAR-10 training accuracies, including three-run results in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds BERT-base fine-tuning experiments on IMDB, reported in Figure 4 and Appendix B, Tables 3–4.

M1.justification: BISR retains the same inverse-square-root banding construction. BandInvMF retains its BISR initialization and sensitivity-based error objective. The added SGD pseudocode and coefficient-computation explanation document the existing method without establishing a procedural change.

E1.justification: v2 adds IMDB sentiment analysis with BERT-base, extending empirical coverage from CIFAR-10 image classification to language-model fine-tuning. The numerical workload experiments and amplified/non-amplified CIFAR-10 coverage remain.

E2.justification: The corresponding numerical comparisons retain BSR, BandMF, and BLT where applicable. CIFAR-10 retains DP-SGD, BSR, and Band-MF comparators; IMDB extends that existing comparator set. BLT remains restricted to prefix-sum comparisons.

E3.justification: The added IMDB evaluation introduces BERT-base fine-tuning at approximately 100 million parameters, with momentum 0.95, weight decay 0.99999, and task-specific learning rates (Table 3). It retains the ten-epoch, batch-size-512, (9, 10^-5)-DP framework. Existing CIFAR-10 and numerical protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The bandwidth analyses, comparisons across participation and optimizer settings, and BandInvMF convergence analysis remain in Figures 1–3 and 5. IMDB adds benchmark evidence, without a distinct new ablation, robustness test, or diagnostic analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report CIFAR-10 means and standard errors over three runs. The added IMDB results use the same reporting practice. No changed run counts, seed practices, confidence procedures, or significance tests are reported.

E6.justification: v2 adds ten-epoch IMDB accuracy trajectories under both amplification settings. For example, amplified epoch-10 accuracies are 89.58±0.17% for BISR, 89.53±0.25% for Band-Inv-MF, and 87.43±0.12% for DP-SGD (Table 4). These are new task-specific results; retained numerical plots and CIFAR-10 Table 2 values are unchanged.

T1.justification: The lower-bound derivation replaces spectral norms with nuclear norms (v1 Lemma 9, Equation 26; v2 Lemma 6, Equation 22). Theorem 3 explicitly adds beta>0, and Corollary 1 changes p*~b log b to p*=O(b log b). Main rates and proof strategies remain. The new proof sketch uses 1/n where the full proof uses 1/sqrt(n), introducing a local inconsistency.

C1.justification: The abstract and principal contributions retain the same claims: explicit and efficient BISR, asymptotically optimal multi-participation error, competitive empirical performance, and optimized inverse coefficients for low-memory operation. Added IMDB evidence supports these existing claims.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly distinguishes asymptotic optimality from superiority at finite sizes and identifies closing the constant-factor gap as future work. It broadens v1's observation about accuracy gains under amplification into an explicit warning that RMSE alone is an insufficient performance proxy.

D1.justification: v2 adds end-to-end SGD pseudocode, a coefficient recurrence with FFT guidance, the CIFAR-10 model's 3-Block ConvNet identification, and IMDB hyperparameters. Listing 1 also changes its import from jax_privacy.dpftrl_mechanisms to jax_privacy.maxtrix_factorization, an apparent typo; its computational logic remains unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references including Balle and Wang's Gaussian calibration, Choquette-Choo et al.'s multi-epoch work, newer correlated-noise and normalized-square-root work, and a production deployment example. The central positioning relative to BSR, BLT, and BandMF remains.

P1.justification: v2 moves the main-text proofs into Appendix A, retains shorter proof sketches, reorganizes auxiliary lemmas, and splits Background into matrix-factorization and privacy-guarantee subsections. The introduction and implementation explanations expand, substantially changing the narrative structure while preserving most scientific content.

P2.justification: Figure 4 expands from two CIFAR-10 panels to four CIFAR-10/IMDB panels, with reordered and recolored legends. Tables 3–4 and an algorithm box are added. Captions expand, Figure 3(d)'s clipped axis labels are restored, and figures and tables are redistributed under a revised page style.

improvement.justification: IMDB fine-tuning adds useful evidence beyond vision, while the nuclear-norm correction repairs a specific lower-bound step. Clearer privacy explanations and finite-size qualifications improve interpretability. These gains are tempered by the new proof-sketch normalization inconsistency and apparent Listing 1 import typo. The resulting overall improvement is useful but limited.
